reading_note: The teaching describes how the operative divine power (Living Spirit) clothes itself in three discrete degrees of reception — perception (wind), love (fire), and natural truth (water) — in order to organize the spiritual cosmos. Through these three garments it imposes order on all works above and below, subjects them, then is stripped of those garments at the boundary so that the rescued good can be purified and conveyed upward through the Zone (firmament) to the Height. The arc: clothing in three degrees → ordering of ultimates → subjection of all works → stripping at the limit → purification → ascent of what was sent forth back to its origin above.
